subject: Request to substitute a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater

messages.text: We're proposing a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater specified in Section 22 34 00 and want sign-off before we order material. We would like this reviewed before the fixture rough-in gets underway. This substitution is cost-neutral. This substitution will not affect the domestic water pressure test date. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track. Note: the unrelated water-meter billing dispute from last month does not apply to this substitution.
